capabilities: edit diagrams in the embedded diagrams.net editor
save diagrams as SVG images with companion XML source files
move and rename diagram files together with their image files
extras: Author states the plugin is no longer maintained and issues will not be read; editing requires an active internet connection because the online editor is embedded; a known issue is that edited diagrams do not refresh in the active editor until reloaded; copying diagrams requires manually duplicating both the image and XML file.
intentEvidence: It differs from the drawio-obsidian plugin in that it embeds the diagrams.net online editor
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to create or edit diagrams.net diagrams inside a vault, forcing users to switch to an external editor.

summary: Diagram editor that embeds the diagrams.net online editor to insert and edit draw.io diagrams stored as SVG images with XML sources.
